## [ui-shell-foundation] Added the staged web shell and initial dashboard integration
- Codebase/domain discoveries: The application is Java 21/Swing with in-process services and Supabase repositories; no Java REST controller exists. Existing RLS scopes company records, profile roles are server-owned, and writes use guarded RPC/Edge Function flows. The checked-in MSI builder fixes BRED product/upgrade identity; those files were not edited.
- Wrong assumptions and corrections: The current Swing navigation and focused viewport regression test were already present as uncommitted user work. Preserved them and added a separate React sidebar test using the source `SIDEBAR_WIDTH` value (252 px), without relying on screenshot measurements.
- Debugging dead-ends and what worked: The first TypeScript build reported missing Node type definitions for Vite config; adding `@types/node` fixed it. Playwright could not launch because Chrome is absent; the Vite HTTP probe and component tests passed, but visual/keyboard preview remains unverified.
- Techniques/patterns worth reusing: Use the public Supabase client with the current user's JWT and database RLS for a read-only first slice; keep auth tokens in memory to match the desktop lifetime; reject privileged browser keys; do not introduce a generic unauthenticated localhost API to access local files/data.
- Learnings consumed: (none)
